subject: Learning Methods
title: What Is Calibration
description: Learn What Is Calibration in one minute.

hook.text: Students predicted they would score 80 percent. They averaged 55. The gap between prediction and reality is calibration.

buildup.text: Calibration measures how well your confidence matches your actual performance. Perfect calibration is rare.

discovery.text: Overconfidence is the most common calibration error. People consistently believe they know more than they do.

twist.text: The worst performers show the largest calibration gap. They are confidently wrong and don't know it.

climax.text: Before every test, predict your score. Compare prediction to result. Track the gap; it should shrink.

punchline.text: Predict, then check. Honest calibration builds skill.

quiz.question: What is calibration in the context of learning?
options: Adjusting the difficulty of study materials
How well your confidence matches your actual performance
Setting the right pace for reading speed
